summary: StyleStudioPage is rewritten on the Pulse kit against style-studio-1 / -2; everything above the return is kept (useElementStyles, useSetElementVariant, the selected state, entry / active / previewable, choose() with both toasts, CATALOG / VARIANTS / VariantOverride / Demo / PREVIEWABLE). Composition as the body script: Screen top=push width=wide > ScreenHeader kind=section (MEGJELENÉS, ELEM-STÍLUS STÚDIÓ, the intro) > hero section (SectionHeader rule=false 'Element · Ex' with the micro state tag on its baseline; the giant Numeral of the active letter with the specimen at 150 % standing on its baseline, or studio.noPreview beside it; the variant name caption) > ChipRow scroll=bleed radiogroup of the 27 options 20 under the hero (RowStack/ListRow radiogroup column at lg, R21) > Section Változatok (+ 'nem használt' trailing for an inert element) with the note or inertExplain and RowStack open close of five rows (48 pt Numeral letter, eyebrow name + micro 'aktív', the 142 pt clipping stage of the real Demo under UnlitPills, the TextLink 'Legyen ez' on the right edge or the CheckMark + 'Ez az aktív' state with aria-current), EmptyState under the list on a failed read. The ELEMENT_ICON map, every Lucide import, the four Surfaces, the Pressable chips and buttons and all legacy classes are gone. Under Q3 (a) every element is dormant on pulse-redesign, so the screen honestly shows 'nem használt', inertExplain and disabled commits for all 27.

So the hero shows 'nem használt' + studio.noPreview instead of 'aktív' + the glowing Save pill, no lime dot after the letters, inertExplain (4 lines) in place of commitNote (3 lines), no row stages, the four 'Legyen ez' disabled (deviations SS-1..SS-7). style-studio-2.reason: fixture-fed (the styles read edited to E1 = C, no PUT: override in states.json) and scrolled to the end, which is the frame's 321 pt scroll. The table (rows A-E, C active with its tag and 'Ez az aktív', D offered again) is reached and lines up row for row with the frame; the toast band is NOT reachable on this page (the save is disabled, SS-9) and is F13's ToastHost.
